title: No Department registration to purchase, store, possess or administer naloxone
rule_summary: Among the exemptions from the requirement to register in 105 CMR 700.004(B), 105 CMR 700.004(B)(11) provides that no person shall be required to register with the Department for the purposes of purchasing, storing, possessing, or administering naloxone, or other opioid antagonist approved by the Department.
exam_relevance: Tests that no person is required to register with the Department for the purposes of purchasing, storing, possessing or administering naloxone or another opioid antagonist approved by the Department.

authority.name: Massachusetts Department of Public Health regulations

common_confusions: Assuming a Department registration is needed to purchase, store, possess or administer naloxone.
Reading the paragraph as speaking of any opioid antagonist when it speaks of naloxone or other opioid antagonist approved by the Department.
verification_notes: Read in the current 105 CMR 700.000 publication on mass.gov, the document generated 2024-02-02, on 2026-09-14.
